subject: [PATCH v3 3/5] NFSD: honour the userspace-rpcbind flag in listener_set

2026-09-15.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFSD listener_set function to honour the userspace-rpcbind flag. When this flag is set, the kernel will not make an rpcbind call and instead sets sv_no_rpcbind on the service. This prevents synchronous rpcbind RPCs under nfsd_mutex and avoids issues with ownership changes. The legacy portlist add-fd interface also refuses to run against a service with this flag set. The patch affects several files in the NFSD codebase, including nfsctl.c, nfsd.h, and nfssvc.c.
